Motor Mechanic-Full-time 

Motor Mechanic-Full-time position vacant at automotive workshop Gladstone Tyres & Auto Pty Ltd trading as Tyrepower Gladstone, ABN:  88 646 303 648, at 93 Hanson Road, Gladstone, Qld-4680. Minimum 38 hours a week. 

Job Description:  

Performing scheduled maintenance services, such as oil changes, lubrications and engine tune-ups, to achieve smoother running of vehicles. 

Repair and replacing worn and defective parts and reassembling mechanical components and referring to service manuals as needed. 

Detecting and diagnosing faults in engines and parts with the assistance of computers. 

Dismantling and removing engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms and other components, and checking parts. 

check and repair suspensions, brakes and wheel alignments of automotive vehicles. 

Reassembling engines and parts following repair. 

Manage stock reordering and inventory as directed, putting the stock (for example brakes, sparkplugs, oil filters) at the proper places. 

Maintain and manage tools, equipment, and machinery in good condition. 

Deliver outstanding customer service at all times, ensuring a professional and polite manner when communicating with customers. 

Full adherence to regulations, relating to pollution and health and safety at all times. 

 

Maintaining a clean and safe working environment through ensuring the correct operation of all tools and specialised equipment. 

 

Coordinating with other mechanics where teamwork was needed. 

 

Applicant must have: 

Completed at least Cert-III in automotive and at least 3 years of full-time work experience as a motor mechanic. Experience in servicing Hybrid cars would be preferred. Must know how to work on Asian, Intercontinental and European car models. 

Must hold a current driver's license and Licensed Vehicle Tester 

A desire to achieve results. 

 

Annual Salary (depending on experience/skills) between $79,000 - $82,000 plus superannuation.  

Only successful candidates will be contacted.

At the Law Society NT, our role extends beyond regulation. We exist to uphold confidence in the legal profession, protect the public interest, and ensure lawyers are supported by a fair, transparent and accountable regulatory framework.

We're now seeking an experienced legal professional to join our Executive Management Group as the Manager of Regulatory Services.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, this is a rare leadership opportunity to influence the integrity, accountability and future of the legal profession across the Northern Territory.

As a key member of the executive team, you will lead the Society's regulatory functions under the Legal Profession Act 2006 (NT), overseeing complaints and investigations, disciplinary matters, trust account regulation, admissions, licensing and professional standards.

This is a role for a senior lawyer who enjoys complex legal work, strategic leadership and making a genuine impact. Your key areas of responsbility will be to:

    Lead the Society's Regulatory Services Unit
    Manage complaints, investigations and disciplinary proceedings
    Act as solicitor on the record in Tribunal and Supreme Court matters
    Provide strategic legal and regulatory advice to Council and Committees
    Oversee trust account and licensing functions
    Support admissions and professional standards activities
    Contribute to policy development and regulatory reform initiatives
    Work closely with the CEO and Executive Management Group to achieve the Society's strategic objectives

To be successful, you will bring:

    Admission as a lawyer in an Australian jurisdiction
    Eligibility to hold an unrestricted practising certificate in the Northern Territory
    At least 7 years post-admission experience
    Strong litigation and advocacy experience
    Proven leadership and people management capability

Experience in professional regulation, investigations, complaints management, administrative law or disciplinary proceedings will be highly regarded.
Why join us?

This is an opportunity to step into a position of genuine influence where your decisions and leadership will contribute to public trust in the administration of the justice system and the ongoing development of the legal profession across the Territory.

If you're looking for a career-defining opportunity that combines legal expertise, leadership and public purpose, we'd love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion, contact our Recruitment Business Partner, Victoria Williams on 03 9691 4712.

result.description:
Autoservice Pinto Repair PTY LTD is seeking a skilled and experienced Automotive Electrician to join our team in Maidstone, Victoria. This is a full-time position that offers an excellent opportunity to work in a dynamic automotive service environment. As an Automotive Electrician, you will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing and maintaining electrical systems in vehicles, ensuring that all work meets safety standards and exceeds customer expectations. This role is integral to our operations, allowing us to deliver high-quality electrical services to our valued clients.
Key responsibilities:
•     Using test equipment to locate electrical and electronic malfunctions.
•     Dismantling and removing electrical and electronic assemblies and components.
•     Installing electrical equipment and electronic components in motor vehicles.
•     Connecting power-operated vehicle equipment and accessories to power supply.
•     Adjusting engine control systems and timing.
•     Testing and replacing defective alternators, generators, voltage regulators and starter motors.
•     Repairing and replacing faulty ignition and electrical wiring.
•     Replacing defective parts such as fuses, lamps and switches.
Qualifications:
•     Certificate III in Automotive Electrical Technology or equivalent qualification.
•     Current Driver Licence.
•     Air Conditioning Handling Licence (preferred but not essential).
Experience:
•     Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as an Automotive Electrician.
•     Experience diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining automotive electrical and electronic systems.
•     Experience working with a wide range of vehicle makes and models.
Skills:
•     Strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills.
•     Ability to repair and maintain vehicle electrical and electronic systems.
•     Knowledge of wiring systems, batteries, charging systems, starters, lighting, and electronic control systems.
•     Ability to use diagnostic equipment and technical manuals.
•     Basic knowledge of Roadworthy Certificate (RWC) inspection requirements and vehicle safety standards.
•     Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
•     Good communication and customer service skills.
•     Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
•     Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

What we offer:
At Autoservice Pinto Repair PTY LTD, we value our employees and are committed to providing a rewarding work environment. We offer competitive remuneration reflecting your skills and experience, ongoing professional development opportunities to keep you current with industry advancements, and a supportive team culture where your expertise is recognised and valued. We provide a safe, well-equipped workshop environment with modern diagnostic tools and equipment to support your work. We also offer flexible working arrangements where possible and encourage a healthy work-life balance. Our team-focused approach means you'll collaborate with experienced technicians and have access to mentorship and training to further develop your career.

About us:
Autoservice Pinto Repair PTY LTD is an automotive repair workshop located in Maidstone, Victoria. The company provides a wide range of automotive services, including mechanical repairs, vehicle servicing, diagnostics, and electrical fault diagnosis. Committed to quality workmanship and customer satisfaction, the business delivers reliable automotive solutions to both private and commercial clients.
